prompts.q: select the survey program, the crops sector and the field crops group
prompts.check: () => { const picked = (id) => [...(document.getElementById(id) || { selectedOptions: [] }).selectedOptions].map((o) => o.text.trim().toUpperCase()); return picked("source_desc").includes("SURVEY") && picked("sector_desc").includes("CROPS") && picked("group_desc").includes("FIELD CROPS"); }

prompts.q: choose corn as the commodity and state as the geographic level, then select 2022 as the year
prompts.check: () => { const picked = (id) => [...(document.getElementById(id) || { selectedOptions: [] }).selectedOptions].map((o) => o.text.trim().toUpperCase()); return picked("commodity_desc").includes("CORN") && picked("agg_level_desc").includes("STATE") && picked("year").includes("2022"); }

prompts.q: pick the census program, the animals & products sector and cattle as the commodity, then click get data
select the environmental sector and then clear the selections
prompts.check: (card) => { const picked = (id) => [...(document.getElementById(id) || { selectedOptions: [] }).selectedOptions].map((o) => o.text.trim().toUpperCase()); return picked("sector_desc").length === 0 && /clear/i.test([card.title, card.sub, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" ")) && /environmental/i.test([card.title, card.sub, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" ")); }

prompts.q: set the geographic level to county and the year to 2017
prompts.check: () => { const picked = (id) => [...(document.getElementById(id) || { selectedOptions: [] }).selectedOptions].map((o) => o.text.trim().toUpperCase()); return picked("agg_level_desc").includes("COUNTY") && picked("year").includes("2017"); }

prompts.q: choose national as the geographic level
how many records are currently available
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/57,8\d\d,\d\d\d|57\.8\d* million/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 1; }

prompts.q: what sectors can I choose from
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/animals/i, /crops/i, /demographics/i, /economics/i, /environmental/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 4; }

prompts.q: what does this page let me do
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/agricultur/i, /commodit/i, /location|state|county/i, /year|time/i, /records|data|statistic/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 3; }
